answer: Deposits are visible in lagoon, and vault reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, an adversary cannot recycle one pool of capital across 171 aliases, and each one needs its own funded orchard account. A bond of 42% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. That bill is paid per identity, so 128 aliases cost 48 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
